about.bio: I am a Principal Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience in designing and implementing cloud-native applications. Skilled in various programming languages and frameworks, I have a proven track record of leading projects that enhance system performance and streamline workflows. My passion for mentoring engineers and delivering impactful solutions drives my commitment to excellence in software development.

philosophy.title: Cloud-Native Architecture
philosophy.desc: I design and implement cloud-native applications on AWS and Azure, using microservices, API Gateway, and Saga patterns to enable independent scaling and resilient deployments.

philosophy.title: Performance Engineering
philosophy.desc: I reduce response times by 40%+ through query optimization, caching strategies, cursor-based pagination, and efficient data pipelines in PostgreSQL and MySQL.

philosophy.title: Security & Reliability
philosophy.desc: I apply IAM governance, secrets management, and encryption standards. CI/CD pipelines with Docker and Kubernetes reduce deployment effort by 70% and improve reliability.

philosophy.title: Mentorship & Leadership
